name: broken_items_purge
note: Town entry, for every roster record: empties any pack slot holding item 0 (BROKEN ITEM). Writes item_state[9] = 0 instead of the slot's own state byte (sic); items_compact runs right after.

name: broken_items_purge
note: Camp entry (camp_main state 1), for every roster record, and after an item breaks: empties any pack slot holding item 0 (BROKEN ITEM).

name: items_compact
note: Moves a character's items up over empty slots; never drops one. Camp entry runs it for every roster record, dead characters in the maze included.

name: party_index_fixup
note: After a roster record is deleted and compacted: drops that index from every party and the current party, and lowers every higher index by one.

name: roster_compact
note: Same as JOUKA's roster_compact: fills each deleted record's slot with the next live one.

name: party_index_fixup
note: remove_lost's renumbering of every party after a Lost member is deleted (same as JOUKA's).

name: remove_lost_members
note: After the Edge of Town's Kadorto: deletes current-party members with status >= 0x200, compacts and renumbers.

name: remove_lost_members
note: Town entry: deletes current-party members with status >= 0x200, compacts and renumbers.

name: inn_party_upkeep
note: Called from inn_stay: deletes Lost members of the current party (renumbering), halves the current party's gold and may break the party up. Current party only. Purpose inferred.

name: party_save_position
note: Writes the square into each current member's roster area/x/y/facing, copies the current party into its parties[] record, snapshots the parties and builds the save image. Seen on leaving the arrival camp (called from camp_main 0x800cf588); the party-table writes rewrote the same values.

name: party_record_clear
note: Empties the current party's parties[] record (count 0, members -1).

name: edge_resume_enter
source: code read 2026-10-11 (P3-fallen); F's note on edge_resume_adventure
note: Resume Adventure, entering: moves every roster record at area 0x17 (4,11) to x=5, dead characters included; loads the chosen member's position; lists other parties' members still in the maze (read only).
